introHtml: White luggage straps offer a clean, neutral canvas that makes your logo or message stand out with high contrast. Whether you need branded straps for corporate travel gifts or employee recognition programs, white straps pair well with any bag color and accept full-color screen-printed or woven labels. Many of our white straps include attached luggage tags for added functionality, making them a practical giveaway for frequent travelers.
